description.la: Enarratio in librum Geneseos, per articulos, cum præfatione de Moyse legislatore.
description.en-US: Denis the Carthusian's article-by-article commentary on the Book of Genesis, opening with a preface on Moses the lawgiver.
description.pt-BR: O comentário de Dionísio, o Cartuxo, ao livro do Gênesis, artigo por artigo, aberto por um prefácio sobre Moisés legislador.

sources.description: Doctoris Ecstatici D. Dionysii Cartusiani Opera Omnia, tomus I (Monstrolii, 1896), pp. 1–469; scan by Cornell University Library. Text read with dots.mocr and proofread page by page by Claude against the scans (research/denis-carthusian).

skip_leaves_why: 0596 is an out-of-focus capture of p. 468, retaken as 0598; its OCR is too garbled for the duplicate check to match it.
